card.name: Symptom onset and clinical manifestation lists
card.fires_on: Words inside descriptions of symptoms and their onset, such as the space before a time span, 'symptoms' after 'Sometimes', or a comma or adjective within a list of signs. It appears where timing or the next sign is expected.

modes.label: Before onset time
modes.description: The space just before a number giving when symptoms start.
modes.example: signs and symptoms of invasive listeriosis start within<< >>1 month of exposure to Listeria

modes.label: Within sign lists
modes.description: The word or comma inside a list of clinical manifestations of a syndrome.
modes.example: Clinical manifestations of NMS are hyperpyrexia, muscle rigidity,<< altered>> mental status and evidence of autonomic instability

card.writes: It suppresses the word for time in English and Chinese, so it may reduce time words where a number or sign should come next.
card.plain: It marks spots in symptom lists and onset descriptions where a number or the next sign comes, not the word time.
